dependencies.name: Forge
dependencies.scope: External unmodified upstream Switch loader; not bundled.

evidence.static_summary: r29: pinned toolchain build; 18 Rust host tests passed plus the mod's ARM and native suites in ./build.sh test, with fixtures that emulate Forge 1.5.1's hook and patch calls: all 22 sites hook or none, a failed hook or flush rolls every site back, a conflict at any site refuses before hooking, a chaining entry stacks on a foreign hook, a foreign word survives rollback, and the observation suite runs the native count bodies through the trampolines and the main-count stub; verify: "PASS: pinned inputs, 22 hook windows and the frame colour setter, NZCVQ/GE audit, exports and payload inventory"; the binary's only SVCs are 0x6, 0x29 and 0x5F.
evidence.manual_summary: User-reported working on Eden and MHGURecomp 0.14.3: "woo, its working for both", unitemized; installed NRO matches on both, and MHGURecomp logged "r29 loaded; forcing and highlights ready".

limitations: A highlighted frame stays white after its item is taken, by the user's choice
r26 ran on Eden master-07677aa500-master with a player report for luck highlights; loading beside a foreign hook on the same entry has not been exercised and rests on Forge's hook.c and host fixtures
Gameplay evidence for r25 is one unitemized user report on Eden (2026-11-02). Ryujinx and native Switch coverage remain unconfirmed.
Individual player-page quantity, Palico exclusion, appraisal/collection, persistence and consecutive-quest checks were not separately reported.
Log contains HLE/keyboard and Maxwell assertions plus an unmapped-memory error; no clean-run or clean-shutdown claim. These emulator messages are not attributed to the plugin.
Native inventory capacity and the 150-entry appraisal queue remain; unsupported records or quantity products above 32767 suppress the entire multiplier attempt.
Ryujinx and physical Switch gameplay are untested.
Successful cache calls do not establish CPU translation freshness; the second forced check broader role remains incompletely traced.
reason: r29: installs all 22 hooks through Forge instead of a private CodeMemory arena, so the plugin can load on MHGURecomp.
target: MHGU Nintendo Switch 1.4.0; upstream Forge 1.5.1; Eden/Ryujinx/MHGURecomp.
